capabilities.name: Governed Semantic Interpretation Boundary
capabilities.responsibility: Represent untrusted natural-language interpretations as typed proposals, deterministically reject unsafe or unresolved executable shapes, route ambiguity to clarification, and emit execution-linked audit artifacts with failure-origin attribution before any interpretation may influence orchestration.
capabilities.authority_role: Zero insurance authority. This boundary may propose request meaning only; it cannot establish policy facts, coverage, claim admissibility, approval, rejection, payment, non-payment, recommendation truth, or publication authority.
safety_invariants: Only a deterministic validator may convert an untrusted interpretation proposal into a downstream-safe validated marker.
AMBIGUOUS and UNRESOLVED interpretations cannot select a governed concept or request an executable semantic fact and must route to clarification.
RESOLVED interpretations must meet their declared resolution threshold and may not retain competing interpretations.
Claim approval, rejection, admissibility, payment and non-payment outcomes are absent from the executable requested-outcome domain.
Every validated interpretation carries interpreter/model/config/input-hash provenance and can be attached to an orchestration execution as a serializable audit artifact.
The capability contains no insurer, product or governed-concept-specific runtime branches.
capabilities.notes: P0 deterministic containment only. No model/provider invocation or orchestration wiring is authorized by this registration. Existing LLM rendering provider/transport infrastructure remains the designated transport reuse candidate for a later phase.
